#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script converted from Slurm
# Note: Flux does not support in-script directives for resource specification
# This script should be submitted with the following command:
# flux batch -N 1 -n 12 -t <time> --job-name=test --output=output.log script.sh
#
# Resource specifications:
# -N 1         : 1 node (from --nodes=1)
# -n 12        : 12 tasks total (from --ntasks-per-node=12 × --nodes=1)
# -t <time>    : walltime (not specified in original, needs to be added)
# --job-name=test : job name (from --job-name test)
# --output=output.log : output file (from --output=output.log)
#
# Note: Add appropriate walltime based on your needs

# Original Slurm partition: lva
# Slurm: --partition=lva
# Note: Flux does not have partitions in the same way as Slurm
# Partition selection is handled through Flux's scheduling configuration
# Performance impact: Job scheduling priority depends on site-specific Flux configuration
# Consult site documentation for equivalent resource pools or queues

# Original Slurm exclusive mode
# Slurm: --exclusive
# Note: Flux does not have a direct --exclusive flag like Slurm
# Flux allocates resources as requested; exclusivity depends on requesting all node resources
# Performance impact: Other jobs may share the node if you don't request all resources
# To ensure exclusivity, request all cores/resources available on the target node
# Consult site documentation for node resource specifications

# Original Slurm job name: test
# Flux: --job-name=test (specified at submission)

# Original Slurm output: output.log
# Flux: --output=output.log (specified at submission)

# Original Slurm nodes: 1
# Flux: -N 1

# Original Slurm ntasks-per-node: 12
# Flux: -n 12 (total tasks with -N 1)

# Execute MPI application
mpirun --mca fs_ufs_lock_algorithm 1 -np 12 ./bin/saveBufferNonCollective

# Note: Consider using 'flux run' instead of 'mpirun' for better integration:
# flux run -n 12 ./bin/saveBufferNonCollective
# The --mca flag would need to be set via environment variables:
# export OMPI_MCA_fs_ufs_lock_algorithm=1

# Complete submission command:
# flux batch -N 1 -n 12 -t <time> --job-name=test --output=output.log script.sh

inputs.script:
#!/bin/bash

# Execute job in the partition "lva" unless you have special requirements.
#SBATCH --partition=lva
# Name your job to be able to identify it later
#SBATCH --job-name test
# Redirect output stream to this file
#SBATCH --output=output.log
# Maximum number of tasks (=processes) to start in total
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=12
#SBATCH --nodes=1
# Maximum number of tasks (=processes) to start per node
# Enforce exclusive node allocation, do not share with other jobs
#SBATCH --exclusive

#!/bin/bash
mpirun --mca fs_ufs_lock_algorithm 1 -np 12 ./bin/saveBufferNonCollective
